title: WP Rocket vs LiteSpeed Cache
description: A documentation-led comparison centered on the hosting constraint behind two popular WordPress performance tools.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped WP Rocket versus LiteSpeed Cache comparison from KreativWP.
comparisonAreas: Dynamic-page exclusions for ecommerce and memberships
A repeatable performance test with one cache plugin at a time
takeaway: Hosting is the first decision: LiteSpeed Cache’s caching features depend on LiteSpeed or QUIC.cloud, while WP Rocket is positioned as a paid page-cache choice for other stacks. Do not run two full-page cache plugins together.
